properties.description: Seven core tests: a pinned decision gives its epoch, checksum and only LATER changes; an unpinned one says it cannot order changes (null, not empty) and points at earliest evidence; the fork point carries the doubt behind the decision; reopening mints a proposed decision that OBSOLETES the original, which stays accepted, and registers the road taken; only an accepted decision can be reopened; the same one is not reopened twice while open; without an address the road taken is not invented.
properties.name: A settled choice gives its fork point, and re-opening it never un-accepts the original
